title: God Promises Abraham
summary: God keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Genesis 15:1-6 and look for how this passage teaches: God keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us.

tell_it: Abram wondered how God's promise would happen. God showed him the stars and Abram believed the Lord.
understand_it: God keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: God Promises Abraham reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Promise matters.
age_8_11_explanation: God Promises Abraham shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: God keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us.
teen_explanation: God Promises Abraham gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that god keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: God keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us.
Faith means trusting God enough to respond.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when promise is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What did God show Abram?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: The stars. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that god keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Genesis 15:5 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in God Promises Abraham?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Star Promise Count
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: God keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from God Promises Abraham. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
